Mode.description: PALINDROME_FUNCTION is a legacy alias. Omitted/null mode defaults to FULL_PROGRAM.

Limits.description: Milliseconds and bytes. Deployment maxima apply (local default CPU 2000 ms, wall 5000 ms, memory 128000000 bytes). wallTimeMs >= cpuTimeMs. FUNCTION limits apply to whole correctness suite; FULL_PROGRAM per test. Benchmark FUNCTION has a separate bounded aggregate budget.

EvaluationRequest.description: Raw body <=2000000 bytes. FUNCTION: exactly one source file and adapterId required. FULL_PROGRAM: adapterId absent/null; fixed entry filenames.

RunRequest.description: Raw body <=2000000 bytes. FUNCTION: exactly one source file and adapterId required. FULL_PROGRAM: adapterId absent/null; fixed entry filenames.

Benchmark.description: 2 warmups and 5 measured rounds when completed. FUNCTION median is elapsed function-call time, in-process and manipulable; peak memory covers whole process including warmups. sandboxCpuTimeMs covers full benchmark process. FULL_PROGRAM reports median sum of process CPU per round. Do not rank FAILED or missing metrics.

TestResult.description: Hidden output, stderr, expectedOutput are null. Compilation errors return no test records. FUNCTION per-test time/memory are null; interrupted batch may report 0 passed and best-effort interrupted index in message.

Job.description: FINISHED means evaluation finished, not necessarily Accepted. FAILED means engine/job failure. QUEUED includes waiting for sandbox. RAM only: all jobs lost at restart; completed results expire after 30 min. Same ID + identical payload replays stored job, different payload -> 409. Use a new ID for an intentional retry after FAILED. No durable exactly-once guarantee.

Error.description: Stable HTTP and job error envelope. Internal exception messages and source code are not returned. Unexpected HTTP 500 errors are not retryable.

path.description: Flat ASCII filename; language-specific extensions and case-insensitive uniqueness enforced by runner

content.description: UTF-8 text. Combined contents limited to 131072 UTF-8 bytes
